sources.title: TPWD Buffalo Bayou Paddling Trail
observations: Names Sabine Street Access as a trail access point and publishes GPS 29.7622, -95.3736.
Lists a Sabine Street to Allen's Landing segment at about one hour and gives the downtown access sequence.
Warns that water quality is generally unsuitable for swimming, high/turbulent water should be avoided, strainers are hazardous, and private-bank use beyond navigable-stream rights can be trespass.
sources.use: Primary confirmation of shared access identity and exact access-site coordinate; it does not claim a survey-grade water-entry toe.

sources.title: TPWD Buffalo Bayou Paddling Trail Map
sources.observation: The official trail map includes Sabine Promenade in Buffalo Bayou Park and the downstream route to Allen's Landing.
sources.use: Corroborates the route layout and access sequence, not exact toe placement.

auditEvidence.before: targeted-before-sabine-allens.json and targeted-before-woodway-sabine.json; Sabine was suspicious at 329.01 feet from the matched flowline and 267.98 feet from mapped water in both route occurrences.
auditEvidence.after: targeted-after-sabine-allens.json and targeted-after-woodway-sabine.json; Sabine now matches the official TPWD access anchor and is classified review; both route audits report zero source issues.
